answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Proof of unique volunteer hours log with charity commission attestation. It requires hours the charity commission verified across projects over years, so the signal of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the tide first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The karst is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
